subject: Privacy & Digital Rights
title: Data as the New Oil
description: A 60-second lesson on Data as the New Oil.

hook.text: In 2017, The Economist declared data more valuable than oil. Tech giants are the new oil barons.

buildup.text: Data fuels AI training, ad targeting, product development, and market predictions.

discovery.text: Unlike oil, data can be copied endlessly, shared infinitely, and never runs out.

twist.text: But like oil, data extraction has costs: privacy erosion, manipulation, and power concentration.

climax.text: The companies that control the most data hold the most power. That's the new resource monopoly.

punchline.text: Data never runs out. Neither does the extraction.

quiz.question: Why is data compared to oil?
options: Both are extremely valuable resources that concentrate power
Data and oil have similar extraction methods
